prompt:
Find real, published data on the Kalshi exchange's trading volume or number of users in 2025. Cite the sources and quote the figures.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

If you're not sure about something, just say so.

response.content:
Here is the published data found regarding Kalshi's trading volume and number of users/transactions in 2025:

**Trading Volume:**
Multiple sources confirm Kalshi's total trading volume for 2025, as well as monthly and daily breakdowns for late 2025.

SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "Kalshi reported a remarkable surge in trading volume for 2025, reaching $23.8 billion, a 1,108% increase from the previous year." | CLAIM: Kalshi's total trading volume for 2025 was $23.8 billion, up 1,108% YoY.
SOURCE: https://phemex.com/news/article/kalshis-2025-trading-volume-soars-to-238-billion-up-1108-51226 | QUOTE: "December alone accounted for $6.38 billion, setting a new monthly record, while December 21 saw a daily peak of $381.7 million." | CLAIM: Kalshi's December 2025 monthly volume was $6.38 billion, and the daily volume peak was $381.7 million on December 21, 2025.
SOURCE: https://www.tradetheoutcome.com/prediction-markets-in-2025-data-stats-key-trends/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi went from roughly $0.85B to an estimated $4.4B the same month, then $5.8B in November and a record $6.38B in December." | CLAIM: Kalshi's monthly trading volumes in late 2025 were approximately $0.85B in September, $4.4B in October, $5.8B in November, and $6.38B in December.
SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi with $1.98B" | CLAIM: Kalshi's weekly notional volume for the final week of 2025 (Dec. 29 - Jan. 4) was roughly $1.98 billion.

**Number of Users/Transactions:**
While a specific "number of users" metric was not found, data on the number of transactions and weekly active traders for late 2025 was available.

SOURCE: https://www.cryptopolitan.com/kalshi-starts-2026-hot-after-record-2025-year/ | QUOTE: "The platform handled 97 million transactions in 2025, which is over 1,680% higher than what it saw in 2024" | CLAIM: Kalshi processed 97 million transactions in 2025, an increase of over 1,680% year-over-year.
SOURCE: https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-record-all-time-high-volume-to-end-2025/ | QUOTE: "Kalshi: 9,502,802" | CLAIM: Kalshi recorded 9,502,802 weekly transactions for the week ending January 4, 2026 (reflecting late Dec 2025/early Jan 2026 activity).

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Total number of unique users or registered user accounts on Kalshi for the year 2025
